استجبن (form X)
# اِسْتَجَبْنَ (istajabna) /is.ta.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجَابَ (istajāba)
# اُسْتُجِبْنَ (ustujibna) /us.tu.d͡ʒib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَابَ (istajāba)
# اِسْتَجِبْنَ (istajibna) /is.ta.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَابَ (istajāba)
